instruction: Organize survey questions into a logical sequence. Group related topics and ensure smooth transitions.

traces.questions: [{"label": "Do you recycle?", "name": "q2"}, {"label": "What is your name?", "name": "name"}, {"label": "How often do you buy organic?", "name": "q1"}]
traces.reasoning: The research question focuses on **sustainability habits**, so questions unrelated to this topic (e.g., "What is your name?") should be excluded. The remaining questions should be logically grouped to assess different dimensions of sustainability behavior—**waste reduction (recycling)** and **consumption choices (organic purchases)**. The order should flow from general habits to specific actions for clarity.

section1.title: General Sustainability Habits
section1.description: Questions about common practices to reduce environmental impact.

section2.title: Consumption Choices
section2.description: Questions about purchasing decisions that support sustainability.
